name: antiaimark
description: Detect and strip AI provenance marks from text, images, documents, video and audio. Tools for Claude Code via MCP.

plugins.name: antiaimark
plugins.description: Detect and strip AI provenance marks: invisible Unicode steganography, C2PA/EXIF/XMP image metadata, container metadata (PDF, DOCX, ODT, SVG, HTML, Markdown, best-effort video), and vendor keywords (OpenAI, Imagen, Firefly, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Ideogram, Recraft, Grok, 豆包·即梦, 腾讯混元, 通义万相, 可灵, 智谱, 文心一格, 海螺…).
